card.name: Repeated heading word at start of text
card.fires_on: A word that repeats the section heading or topic just before it, such as 'Pediatric In pediatric' or 'Lithium Lith-ium'. It fires on the second copy of the heading word at the start of the section's first sentence.

modes.label: Heading echoed in section start
modes.description: A section heading word like Pediatric or Lithium is immediately repeated at the start of the body text.
modes.example: Pediatric In<< pediatric>> patients weighing less than 35 kg

modes.label: Lithium echoed
modes.description: The word Lithium is restarted after a Lithium heading, firing on the ending piece.
modes.example: 7.5 Lithium Lith<<ium>> toxicity has been reported in patients receiving lithium

modes.label: Other repeated topic word
modes.description: A topic word in a title or lead phrase is repeated right after, in general web text or lists.
modes.example: Drug Interactions Known<< drug>> interactions include barbiturates, tranquil

card.plain: It notices when a section heading's key word is repeated at the start of the text under it.
